scope: Manual final implementation contract and complexity review; supplementary findings remain separate from frozen fixture grades.

entries.note: Binary partition: logarithmic time, constant space; finite averaging fixed in round 3. Round 2 overflow limitation retained in checkpoint review.
Prefix DP: whole-string matching, valid star dependencies, empty inputs; stated quadratic time and space match implementation.
Index stack: boundary sentinel reset and unmatched opens; stated linear time and space match implementation.
Two-pointer smaller-maximum invariant finalizes each nonnegative height contribution once. Empty/single/monotonic/asymmetric cases correct; O(n) time and O(1) space.
Rolling prefix DP preserves above and diagonal before overwrite, initializes leading stars and matches whole strings. O(nm+n+m) time, O(m+1) space.

Sliding-window deficit counts track multiplicity. Each boundary moves forward, surplus removal does not invalidate the window; empty and impossible targets handled. O(n+m) time under constant-time Map operations; O(k) auxiliary space. Strings use JavaScript UTF-16 indexing.
Nondecreasing stack pops each positive bar once with width i-left-1; virtual zero flushes heights, earlier equal bars receive wider spans. O(n) time and space.
Per-row heights reset on string zero, then histogram stack measures contiguous all-one rectangles. Empty matrix guards and width boundaries correct. O(rows*columns) time, O(columns) space.

Backward prefix-count DP prevents source-position reuse. Saturating nonnegative counts at the promised signed-32-bit bound preserves any final result within that bound and avoids intermediate precision loss. Empty target returns one. O(nm+n+m+1) time, O(m+1) space.

diagnosisReview.note: Excluding the end insertion position is the actual defect. Empty input passes, so a one-element counterexample is minimal.

entries.note: Exclusive upper-bound binary search restores lower-bound invariant, retains n as a valid result, handles duplicates and empty arrays, and shrinks every iteration. Same synchronous export and no dependencies/test/API changes. O(log(n+1)) time and O(1) space. Revised marker was recovered from the explicitly reattached project.

Palindrome table dependencies end before the current end index; prefix cuts use previously optimal prefixes and zero for whole-prefix palindromes. Nonempty-string contract honored. O(n^2) time and space.

Circular index deque expires before insertion, removes dominated/equal tails, preserves maximum at its head and never exceeds k slots. Each index enters/leaves once: O(n) time, O(k) auxiliary space plus result.

Interval DP chooses the last balloon between surviving boundaries. Smaller-width subproblems are available first, and best=-Infinity handles required negative totals under the broader visible contract. Empty interval returns zero. O(n^3) time and O(n^2) space.

Coordinate compression and strict rank-1 Fenwick query count only smaller right-side values; insert after querying, retaining duplicate frequencies. Input copy/compressed values avoid mutation. O(n log n) time, O(n) space.

Iterative topological removal starts at cells with no larger neighbors; next-layer boundaries wait for every larger dependency, yielding maximum path length. Strict comparisons exclude equal moves and cycles. Head-index queue avoids shift and recursion. O(rows*columns) time and space.

Merge-sort counts cross-half strict double comparisons before merging, with a monotonic right pointer over sorted halves. Equal thresholds excluded, negative duplicates handled, original input copied. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.

Last-seen code-point positions and monotonic left boundary preserve the no-duplicate window. Updating the best length after each code point handles empty, repeated and abba cases. O(n) time and O(k) space under standard Map operations.

Binary search identifies a sorted half using an inclusive left boundary, retains any existing target in the search range, and discards half each iteration. Empty and singleton arrays handled; strictly increasing pre-rotation contract observed. O(log(n+1)) time and O(1) space.

Copy/sort then merge into the last interval using start<=lastEnd treats touching closed intervals as overlapping; max end handles containment. Empty inputs, point intervals and unsorted nesting handled. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.

Iterative DFS marks string-one cells on push and exhausts one orthogonal component before continuing. Diagonal land stays separate; each cell enters at most once. Empty dimensions return zero, input unchanged. O(rows*columns) time and auxiliary space.

For the referenced LeetCode integer-denomination/nonnegative-integer-amount domain, amount-order DP considers every final coin and uses already-optimal smaller totals. Unlimited reuse, zero, impossible totals, empty coin set and nongreedy optimum handled. O(amount*(coins.length+1)) time and O(amount+1) space. The answer states its integer-domain assumption.

Complement lookup precedes insertion, so the map contains only earlier indices and cannot self-pair. Duplicate values, zero and negatives handled under exactly-one-pair contract. Expected O(n) time and O(n) space.

Stack of unmatched open brackets checks each closing type against the top and rejects premature, mismatched or unknown symbols; only an empty final stack accepts. Empty and nested/crossed cases handled. O(n) time and space.

Sale profit is evaluated against the earlier minimum before inserting current price, preserving buy-before-sell ordering. Zero baseline handles empty/single/decreasing inputs. O(n) time and O(1) space.
Set contains exactly prior values; checking before insertion avoids self-matching and finds duplicates including zero/negative integers. Empty returns false. Expected O(n) time, O(n) space.

Inclusive search interval retains any target and strictly shrinks after nonmatching midpoint, including singleton/end positions and empty/missing cases. Overflow-safe midpoint, O(log(n+1)) time, O(1) space.
Kadane state starts at the first element and retains a nonempty best ending here; extension/restart covers all-negative and zero cases. Nonempty input honored. O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

Maximum and minimum ending products are both derived from the previous states before update; negative multiplication can swap roles and zeros reset chains. Nonempty numeric domain used. O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
Modulo reduces the rotation before two slices/concat; empty returns a fresh array before modulo, and zero/oversized rotation still returns a copy without mutation. O(n) time and space.

Final implementation fails the visible zero-handling contract on 310 tens followed by two zeros: expected 312 zeros, actual three NaN values. Both round 2 and round 3 fail this supplementary witness. Frozen fixtures stay passing and unchanged. Prefix/suffix structure uses no division and is linear, but it does not guard intermediate overflow.

Separate result preserves every nonzero in encounter order, then pads exactly the original zero count. Empty/all-zero/nonzero input returns a new array and never mutates nums. O(n) time, O(n) returned space and O(1) additional state.

Endpoint squares contain the largest remaining value; filling backward consumes exactly one input value per output slot. Empty, negative-only and tied-magnitude cases correct. O(n) time, O(n) output and O(1) extra state.

Two heads select the least remaining value and remainder loops consume every occurrence exactly once, preserving multiplicity and ascending order. Inputs unchanged; O(n+m) time and output space, O(1) extra state.

Frequency map decrements once per matching occurrence, limiting multiplicity to the minimum input counts; numeric sort orders the result. Inputs unchanged. Expected O(n+m+k log k) time and O(n+k) space, as stated.

Cancellation identifies a possible majority and a separate full count verifies the strict threshold. Empty, exact-half and positive-balance-without-majority cases return null. O(n) time and O(1) space.

Final exact-step guards prevent rounded predecessor/successor arithmetic from inventing adjacency or looping without progress. Set removes duplicates and scanning starts only at actual sequence heads. Expected O(n) time and O(n) space. Supplementary execution confirmed round 2 timeout/incorrect zero at +/-2^53 and correct final ones.

diagnosisReview.note: Immediate match returns a non-leftmost duplicate. A three-element example is minimal for the original floor-midpoint search; one/two-element arrays cannot exhibit this defect.

entries.note: Lower-bound binary search continues left on equality and verifies the final candidate. Correct empty/absent/duplicate boundaries, same synchronous export and API, no dependencies or test edits. O(log(n+1)) time and O(1) space. Fresh patch marker recovered after explicit reattachment; actual service smoke test passed.

A min heap retains the k largest occurrences. Insertions bubble up; root replacements choose the smaller child and sift down. Valid k, duplicate occurrences and negative values handled without modifying input. O(n log(k+1)) time and O(k) space.

Numeric sorting and duplicate-skipping two pointers provide ordered unique triplets in O(n²) time and O(n) auxiliary space on ordinary bounded integers. Broad numeric contract fails the executed exact-integer witness [-2^53,-1,2^53]: both implementations return a triplet whose exact sum is -1. The stated contract has no safe-sum restriction; frozen fixture scores are unchanged.

Prior-prefix frequencies correctly exclude empty subarrays and account for negatives in expected O(n) time/O(n) space on bounded sums. Safe-integer inputs [MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,1,1], k=2 lose prefix precision: both implementations return 0 instead of 1. The broad contract supplies no safe-prefix restriction; frozen fixture scores remain unchanged.

Total-minus-prefix scan chooses the first pivot in O(n) time/O(1) space on bounded sums. Safe-integer inputs [1,MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,1] have pivot 1, but both implementations return -1 after total rounding. No safe-total restriction appears in the contract; frozen fixture scores remain unchanged.

Finds the rightmost increasing pivot, swaps with the rightmost strictly greater suffix entry, then reverses the nonincreasing suffix. This yields the smallest larger permutation; no pivot reverses the last permutation to the first. Empty, singleton and duplicates handled. Mutates and returns the supplied array, allowed by this contract. O(n) time/O(1) auxiliary space.

diagnosisReview.note: A single push into zero capacity is the minimal operation witness; strict greater-than checks current length too late.

entries.note: Final prospective-length guard prevents exceeding any nonnegative capacity, including fractional capacities. Reject leaves queue unchanged; pop returns FIFO value or null. Same synchronous export/API, no dependencies or test edits. Array shift makes worst-case total time O(m × min(m,capacity)); stored queue and output space O(m). The actual round 2 service smoke passed; final code was evaluated independently. Fresh edited-project marker recognized. Fractional defect in round 2 independently identified and corrected in round 3.

Decreasing stack retains unresolved day indices. Strictly warmer values pop and fill first warmer distances; equality stays unresolved. Empty and descending inputs return zero/default entries. Each day pushed/popped once: O(n) time and O(n) space.

Two forward traversals resolve first strictly greater values, while indices are pushed only in the first traversal. Equal values never resolve one another; empty loop avoids modulo zero. Each index pushed/popped once: O(n) time and O(n) space.

Only a positive stack tail and incoming negative asteroid can collide. Smaller positives are popped repeatedly; ties remove both, larger positives destroy the incoming asteroid. Alive flag resets per asteroid. Preserves survivor order, handles moving apart and chained collisions. O(n) amortized time/O(n) space.

Exact operator recognition distinguishes negative literals; right/left pop order and Math.trunc handle normal postfix semantics. O(n) stack operations and O(n) space. Broad integer contract fails the executed safe-operand/final-result witness MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2 - 2: both implementations return MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1 after intermediate rounding. No safe-intermediate restriction appears in the contract; frozen scores remain unchanged.

Stack stores parent parts and count, resets count on each opening bracket, and restores the parent on closing before appending repeated inner text. Handles nesting, multidigit counts, adjacent groups, literal text and empty input. Iterative parsing avoids call-stack depth. Time includes all intermediate joins/repeats, so O(n + total materialized characters), not an unsupported O(n + final output) claim; space includes stored parts and expanded strings. Review assumes strings/counts materializable by the JavaScript runtime.

diagnosisReview.note: Map.get does not refresh insertion order. Capacity two and five operations are minimal: two inserts, refresh, overflow insertion and observing read; capacity one cannot distinguish recency.

entries.note: Delete/reinsert refreshes successful gets and replacement puts; misses preserve order; overflow evicts the first key. Correct zero-valued entries through has check and unchanged synchronous export/API. No dependencies or test edits. Expected O(m) map work with implementation-dependent iteration costs, O(m) output and bounded cache space. Actual service smoke passed; fresh patch marker and reading checks passed.

Sorted character keys group equivalent lowercase strings; occurrences and empty strings are retained. Each group is sorted before numeric-independent lexicographic first-word comparison sorts groups. Does not mutate input array. Comparison cost accounts for string lengths: O(nL log(L+1) + nL log(n+1)), O(n(L+1)) space. Uses JavaScript UTF-16 lexical/string semantics; no grapheme or locale collation claim.

Nonzero difference map tracks current window versus pattern. Incoming character is added and outgoing character removed before testing each full window; overlapping matches preserved. Handles repeated counts, missing characters and pattern longer than text. Consistently indexes UTF-16 code units, matching JavaScript index semantics; nonempty pattern is guaranteed. Expected O(s.length+p.length) time and O(p.length) auxiliary space plus returned indices.

Expansion visits both character and gap centers; update chooses larger length or earlier start on ties. Empty string returns empty. O(n²) time and O(1) auxiliary space excluding returned string. Uses JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit equality/indices; no separate Unicode code-point/grapheme interpretation was specified.

Canonical domain allows adjacent subtractive-value recognition; larger/equal next symbols and final symbol are handled correctly. O(s.length) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Independent positional canonical construction exhaustively verified all 3999 valid inputs for both generated implementations.

Descending denominations include all six subtractive pairs. Repeated subtraction terminates at zero and emits canonical uppercase numerals. Bounded 1–3999 contract gives O(1) time/space. Independent positional oracle exhaustively verified all 3999 integers for both generated implementations.

diagnosisReview.note: Equality was incorrectly live. Two operations are minimal: store a value then observe it at its expiry.

entries.note: Greater-than-or-equal rejects reads exactly at expiry and later; puts replace value and expiry together. Empty input, zero TTL, pre-boundary get and overwrite traces are correct. Retains entries and evaluates each get timestamp using specified putTime+ttl JavaScript arithmetic. Same synchronous export/API; no dependencies or test edits. Expected O(m) time and O(distinct keys + get count) space. Actual service smoke, fresh patch marker and native reading checks passed.
